description: This file defines the WebserviceField class, which models a field in the web service API of the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for retrieving field metadata, such as name, label, type, default value, and related reference data, as well as static caches for database metadata. The class helps manage and access metadata for CRM fields, facilitating web service operations.

classes.name: WebserviceField
classes.description: A class representing a CRM database field used in web services, encapsulating field metadata, type info, and reference data, with methods for metadata access and cache management.

methods.name: fromQueryResult
methods.description: Creates a WebserviceField instance from a database query result row using the specified row number.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a WebserviceField instance directly from an array representing field data.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table containing this field.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: getFieldLabelKey
methods.description: Returns the label of the field.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the field.

methods.name: isMandatory
methods.description: Returns whether the field is mandatory.

methods.name: getTypeOfData
methods.description: Returns the type of data associated with the field.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type of the field.

methods.name: getMassEditable
methods.description: Returns whether the field is editable in bulk.

methods.name: getFieldId
methods.description: Returns the internal ID of the field.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default value for the field, filling column meta if needed.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of the database column.

methods.name: getBlockId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the block the field belongs to.

methods.name: getBlockName
methods.description: Returns the name of the block the field belongs to, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: getTabId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the tab/module.

methods.name: isNullable
methods.description: Returns whether the field can be null.

methods.name: hasDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether the field has a default value.

methods.name: getUIType
methods.description: Returns the UI type of the field.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the field is read-only.

methods.name: setNullable
methods.description: Sets the nullability of the field.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default value for the field.

methods.name: setFieldDataType
methods.description: Sets the field's data type.

methods.name: setReferenceList
methods.description: Sets the list of referenced types for the field.

methods.name: getTableFields
methods.description: Returns metadata about all fields in the table.

methods.name: fillColumnMeta
methods.description: Loads column metadata from the database into the object.

methods.name: getFieldDataType
methods.description: Determines and returns the data type of the field based on UI type and metadata.

methods.name: getReferenceList
methods.description: Fetches and caches the list of reference types for this field.

methods.name: getFieldTypeFromTable
methods.description: Retrieves the data type from the database table metadata.

methods.name: getFieldTypeFromTypeOfData
methods.description: Determines field type from 'typeofdata' attribute.

methods.name: getFieldTypeFromUIType
methods.description: Retrieves field type based on UI type from the vtiger_ws_fieldtype table, caching results.

methods.name: getPicklistDetails
methods.description: Returns picklist options, either hardcoded or from database.

methods.name: getPickListOptions
methods.description: Fetches picklist options from database, localizing labels.

methods.name: getPresence
methods.description: Returns the presence/status of the field.
